competing_explanation: The current policy may specify a different return window, limit full refunds to a shorter period, or exclude standard items from full-refund eligibility.
hypothesis_statement: The current return policy for standard items provides a 30-day full-refund return window, meaning standard items may be returned within 30 days for a full refund.
refutation_criterion: Refuted if an authoritative current policy source states that the full-refund return window for standard items is not 30 days, that full refunds are not available for standard items, or that the 30-day window applies only to non-standard items or a different refund type.
